details.notes:
Published to npm as `@bitkyc08/opencodex@2.88.0` with dist-tag `latest`.

## Bug Fixes

- Preserve carry reference numbers across the text window cap (#7252)
- Carry account recovery, server-tool buffer, and usage corrections (#7236)
- Skip unused native Codex ownership probes (#7184)
- Replay Anthropic server-tool exchanges on the translated lane (carry #7205) (#7251)
- Stop leaked Gemini planning from spreading through replayed history (#7254)
- Preserve OpenAI API display name overrides (#7259)
- Price refused-then-served rows in routing analytics (#7253)
- Preserve startup with IPv6 loopback disabled (#7262)
- Return gateway request-history IDs (#7261)
- Reclaim least recently used idle WebSocket at capacity (#7095)
- Route Claude through Anthropic Messages (#7235)
- Recover rejected thinking without local prefix validation (#7147)

## Documentation

- Clarify the app-server shim transport limit (#7227)

## Other Changes

- Open dev at 2.88.0 before releasing 2.87.0 (#7248)
- Promote dev 7761e04edb to main as 2.88.0 (#7264)
